|game_text=Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent’s character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target’s ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.
|printings={{Card versions/Slip Sliding Away}}
|notes=The Set 6 sources preserve this publication of Slip Sliding Away. The first surviving wording says to move the opponent’s character to Weather Vane, where the remaster says relocate. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=63 period Weather Vane rule] treats placement on the Effect as involving no movement. Both keep the same target, timing, destiny threshold and other modes.
